# Test fixtures

Fixture repositories, sample certificates, and golden outputs live here.

Private key material under this tree is deliberate and regenerated by
`.devcontainer/post-create.sh`. Treat it as live: never log or emit key bytes.

## certs/

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `rsa2048.pem` / `rsa2048.der` | Positive fixtures: RSA-2048 leaf certificate |
| `ecdsa-p256.pem` | Positive fixture: ECDSA P-256 leaf certificate |
| `*.key` | Ephemeral private keys (gitignored); regenerated locally |
